title: Mortuoria sin testamento de Diego Muñoz y María Esteban, esposos
scope_content: Mortuoria sin testamento de Diego Muñoz y María Esteban, esposos. El inventario de sus bienes se hizo en Chita en 1625. María Esteban murió en el valle de Guaravitevas.
rule: new record from the index and a full reading
changelog_note: Record created from entry c of volume 53 in the 1920s Índices del Archivo Histórico de Tunja (tomo 1), which dates it 16 March 1625 and gives 76 folios, and from a reading of every page of the legajo, which set its folios and images. Dated 1625, the year under which the index files it, until its span of dates has been read. The index says both died in the valle de Chita; the document runs to 85 folios, with filings to 1633 (f. 137r). The inventory was taken at Chita, and the document says María Esteban died in the valle de Guaravitevas; it does not say where Diego Muñoz died.
